evidence.title: Unit testing expected exceptions
evidence.explanation: assertRaises succeeds when the wrapped code raises the expected exception.
evidence.misconception: Assumes the expected error is printed after the test.

evidence.title: While loops
evidence.explanation: Integer division halves n until it reaches zero.

evidence.title: Properties
evidence.explanation: @property exposes method behavior using attribute access.

evidence.title: Dictionary comprehensions
evidence.explanation: The comprehension creates entries for odd x only.
evidence.misconception: Reverses the filter and selects even keys.

evidence.title: Sliding windows
evidence.explanation: Compute the maximum sum of each contiguous window of k elements.

evidence.title: try-except-else-finally
evidence.explanation: else runs when try succeeds; finally runs whether or not an exception occurred.
evidence.misconception: Assumes else does not run without an error.

evidence.title: Closure and nonlocal
evidence.explanation: nonlocal allows the inner function to update the enclosing function variable.

evidence.title: File I/O and context managers
evidence.explanation: The with statement closes the file; mode controls reading, replacing, or appending.
evidence.misconception: Possible confusion about file i/o and context managers: selected 'with open(path, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:' instead of the most directly applicable answer. Verify with another item.

evidence.title: Resource-safe composition
evidence.explanation: The contextmanager decorator runs setup before yield and cleanup after the with-body.
evidence.misconception: Assumes context manager setup print is skipped.

evidence.title: finally execution
evidence.explanation: The finally block executes before the function completes its return.
evidence.misconception: Assumes finally suppresses the return value without a replacement return.

evidence.title: List comprehensions
evidence.explanation: Only even values of i are squared and collected.
evidence.misconception: Selects odd values instead of even ones.

evidence.title: Class methods
evidence.explanation: A classmethod receives the class as cls and can access class attributes.

evidence.title: List slicing assignment
evidence.explanation: Slice assignment replaces the selected span with the supplied iterable.
evidence.misconception: Replaces only index 2, not the full slice.

evidence.title: Recursive sum
evidence.explanation: Recursive calls accumulate numbers from n down to 1.

evidence.title: Algorithmic complexity
evidence.explanation: Use the specified algorithm and average-case qualifier where applicable.
evidence.misconception: Possible confusion about algorithmic complexity: selected 'O(n²)' instead of the most directly applicable answer. Verify with another item.

evidence.title: Test isolation
evidence.explanation: Unit tests should isolate external side effects and control unpredictable dependencies.
evidence.misconception: Possible confusion about test isolation: selected 'call a real test account for every unit test' instead of the most directly applicable answer. Verify with another item.

evidence.title: Time complexity
evidence.explanation: Count how the number of operations grows with input size, under the stated average-case assumption.
evidence.misconception: Possible confusion about time complexity: selected 'O(log n)' instead of the most directly applicable answer. Verify with another item.

evidence.title: Exception identification
evidence.explanation: Identify the operation that fails: conversion, zero division, or list indexing.
evidence.misconception: Confuses this failure with IndexError; check how the operation fails.

evidence.title: JSON serialization and numeric values
evidence.explanation: JSON round-tripping preserves these integer values; dividing 9 by 2 yields 4.5.

evidence.title: Conditional branches
evidence.explanation: Only the branch whose condition is true runs.
evidence.misconception: Prints the condition value rather than the branch message.

evidence.title: Independent instance state
evidence.explanation: Each new Counter gets its own n instance attribute.
evidence.misconception: Assumes inc() does not change instance state.

evidence.title: List indexing
evidence.explanation: -2 indexes the second element from the end.

evidence.title: Assertions
evidence.explanation: An assert statement has no effect when its condition evaluates to True.
evidence.misconception: Assumes assert prints its boolean condition.

evidence.title: Default arguments
evidence.explanation: The supplied positional argument overrides the default times=2.
evidence.misconception: Uses the default repeat count instead of the explicit argument.

evidence.title: Class attributes
evidence.explanation: Instances can look up a shared class attribute if no instance attribute overrides it.
evidence.misconception: Confuses the class name with its class attribute value.

evidence.title: Mutable default arguments
evidence.explanation: The default list is created once when the function is defined and is shared across calls.
